40022521.author: पदार्थः
40022521.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, भाषितं spoken, वाक्यं words, मम my, राम O Rama, शुभाक्षरम् auspicious-worded, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, प्रत्युवाच replied, इदं this, सः he, स्वर्गी the celestial being, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022521.author: Translation
40022521.content: O Rama, O delight of the Raghus, having heard my auspicious words, that celestial being replied with folded hands.

40022522.author: पदार्थः
40022522.content: शृणु listen, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, पुरा formerly, वृत्तं the story, मम my, एतत् this, सुखदुःखयोः of joys and sorrows, अनतिक्रमणीयं unavoidable, हि indeed, यथा as, पृच्छसि you ask, मां me, द्विज O twice-born.

40022522.author: Translation
40022522.content: O Brahmana, O twice-born, listen to this unavoidable story of my past joys and sorrows, as you have asked me.

40022523.author: पदार्थः
40022523.content: पुरा formerly, वैदर्भकः of Vidarbha, राजा king, पिता father, मम my, महायशाः greatly renowned, सुदेवः Sudeva, इति thus, विख्यातः famous, त्रिषु in three, लोकेषु worlds, वीर्यवान् valorous.

40022523.author: Translation
40022523.content: Formerly, my father was a greatly renowned and valorous king of Vidarbha, famous in all three worlds by the name Sudeva.

40022524.author: पदार्थः
40022524.content: तस्य his, पुत्रद्वयं two sons, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, द्वाभ्यां from two, स्त्रीभ्याम् wives, अजायत were born, अहं I, श्वेतः Shveta, इति thus, ख्यातः known, यवीयान् the younger, सुरथः Suratha, अभवत् was.

40022524.author: Translation
40022524.content: O Brahmana, he had two sons born from two wives; I was known as Shveta, and the younger one was Suratha.

40022525.author: पदार्थः
40022525.content: ततः then, पितरि when the father, स्वर्याते had gone to heaven, पौराः the citizens, माम् me, अभ्यषेचयन् consecrated, तत्र there, अहं I, कृतवान् did, राज्यं kingship, धर्म्यं righteous, च and, सुसमाहितः very attentively.

40022525.author: Translation
40022525.content: Then, when my father had passed away to heaven, the citizens consecrated me, and I diligently performed righteous kingship there.

40022526.author: पदार्थः
40022526.content: एवं thus, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, समतीतानि passed, सुव्रत O virtuous one, राज्यं kingdom, कारयतः while ruling, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, प्रजा subjects, धर्मेण righteously, रक्षतः while protecting.

40022526.author: Translation
40022526.content: O virtuous one, O Brahmana, thus thousands of years passed while I ruled the kingdom and protected the subjects righteously.

40022527.author: पदार्थः
40022527.content: सः that, अहं I, निमित्ते on an occasion, कस्मिंश्चित् some, विज्ञातायुः having known my lifespan, द्विजोत्तम O best of Brahmanas, कालधर्मं the law of time (death), हृदि in my heart, न्यस्य having placed, ततः then, वनं to the forest, उपागमम् I went.

40022527.author: Translation
40022527.content: O best of Brahmanas, having known my lifespan due to some cause, I then accepted the law of time in my heart and went to the forest.

40022528.author: पदार्थः
40022528.content: सः that, अहं I, वनं forest, इदं this, दुर्गं inaccessible, मृगपक्षिविवर्जितम् devoid of deer and birds, तपः penance, चर्तुं to perform, प्रविष्टः entered, अस्मि I am, समीपे near, सरसः of the lake, शुभे auspicious.

40022528.author: Translation
40022528.content: I entered this inaccessible forest, devoid of deer and birds, to perform penance near an auspicious lake.

40022529.author: पदार्थः
40022529.content: भ्रातरं brother, सुरथं Suratha, राज्ये in the kingdom, हि indeed, अभिषिच्य having consecrated, महीपतिम् as king, इदं this, सरः lake, समासाद्य having reached, तपः penance, तप्तं performed, मया by me, चिरम् for a long time.

40022529.author: Translation
40022529.content: Indeed, having consecrated my brother Suratha as king in the kingdom, I reached this lake and performed penance for a long time.

40022530.author: पदार्थः
40022530.content: सः that, अहं I, वर्षसहस्राणि thousands of years, तपः penance, त्रीणि three, महावने in the great forest, तप्त्वा having performed, सुदुष्करं very difficult, प्राप्तः attained, ब्रह्मलोकं the world of Brahma, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed.

40022530.author: Translation
40022530.content: Having performed very difficult penance for three thousand years in the great forest, I attained the unsurpassed world of Brahma.

40022531.author: पदार्थः
40022531.content: तस्य of that, मे to me, स्वर्गभूतस्य having become heavenly, क्षुत्पिपासे hunger and thirst, द्विजोत्तम O best of Brahmins, बाधेते afflict, परमोदार O most generous one, ततः then, अहम् I, व्यथितेन्द्रियः with distressed senses, गत्वा having gone, त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठम् to the best of the three worlds, पितामहम् to the grandfather, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.

40022531.author: Translation
40022531.content: O best of Brahmins and most generous one, even after attaining heaven, hunger and thirst afflicted me, causing my senses distress, so I went and spoke to the grandfather, Brahma, the best of the three worlds.

40022532.author: पदार्थः
40022532.content: भगवन् O venerable one, ब्रह्मलोकः Brahma's world, अयम् this, क्षुत्पिपासाविवर्जितः devoid of hunger and thirst, कस्य of what, अयम् this, कर्मणः of action, पाकः fruit, क्षुत्पिपासानुगः followed by hunger and thirst, हि indeed, अहम् I.

40022532.author: Translation
40022532.content: O venerable one, this Brahma-loka is free from hunger and thirst, so what deed's consequence is it that I am indeed still afflicted by hunger and thirst?

40022533.author: पदार्थः
40022533.content: आहारः food, कः what, च and, मे for me, देव O god, तत् that, मे to me, ब्रूहि tell, पितामह O grandfather.

40022533.author: Translation
40022533.content: O divine grandfather, please tell me what my food should be.

40022534.author: पदार्थः
40022534.content: पितामहः the grandfather, तु indeed, माम् to me, आह said, तव your, आहारः food, सुदेवज O son of a good god, स्वादूनि delicious, स्वानि your own, मांसानि flesh, तानि those, भक्षय eat, नित्यशः always.

40022534.author: Translation
40022534.content: The grandfather, Brahma, then told me, "O son of a good god, your food shall be your own delicious flesh, which you must eat constantly."

40022535.author: पदार्थः
40022535.content: स्वशरीरम् one's own body, त्वया by you, पुष्टम् nourished, कुर्वता while performing, तपः penance, उत्तमम् excellent, अनुप्तम् unsown, रोहते grows, श्वेत O white one, न not, कदाचित् ever, महामते O great-minded one.

40022535.author: Translation
40022535.content: O great-minded and white one, your body, which you nourished through excellent penance, will not grow back once consumed, just as something unsown never sprouts.

40022536.author: पदार्थः
40022536.content: तृप्तिः satisfaction, न not, ते to you, अस्ति is, सूक्ष्मा even a little, अपि even, वने in the forest, सत्वनिषेविते inhabited by creatures, पुरा formerly, तु but, भिक्षमाणाय to one begging, भिक्षा alms, वै indeed, यतये to an ascetic, नृप O king, न not, हि indeed, दत्ता given, त्वया by you, इन्द्राभ O Indra-like one, यस्मात् because, अतिथये to a guest, अपि even, वै indeed.

40022536.author: Translation
40022536.content: O King, even a little satisfaction is not yours in this forest inhabited by creatures, because formerly, O Indra-like one, you did not give alms to a begging ascetic, nor indeed to any guest.

40022537.author: पदार्थः
40022537.content: दत्तम् charity, न not, ते to you, अस्ति is, सूक्ष्मः even a little, अपि even, तपः penance, एव only, निषेवसे you practiced, तेन therefore, स्वर्गगतः having gone to heaven, वत्स O child, बाध्यसे you are tormented, क्षुत्पिपासया by hunger and thirst.

40022537.author: Translation
40022537.content: You have not given even a little charity, having only practiced penance; therefore, O child, even after reaching heaven, you are tormented by hunger and thirst.

40022538.author: पदार्थः
40022538.content: सः that, त्वम् you, सुपुष्टम् well-nourished, आहारैः with food, स्वशरीरम् your own body, अनुत्तमम् excellent, भक्षयित्वा having eaten, अमृतरसम् the nectar-like essence, तेन by that, तृप्तिः satisfaction, भविष्यति will be.

40022538.author: Translation
40022538.content: You, having eaten the nectar-like essence of your own excellent body, which was well-nourished with food, will then find satisfaction.

40022539.author: पदार्थः
40022539.content: यदा when, तु but, तत् that, वनम् forest, श्वेत O Śveta, अगस्त्यः Agastya, सुमहानृषिः the great sage, आगमिष्यति will come, दुर्धर्षः unconquerable, तदा then, कृच्छ्रात् from distress, विमोक्ष्यते he will be liberated.

40022539.author: Translation
40022539.content: But, O Śveta, when the great and unconquerable sage Agastya comes to that forest, then you will be liberated from your distress.

40022540.author: पदार्थः
40022540.content: सः he, हि indeed, तारयितुम् to save, सौम्य O gentle one, शक्तः capable, सुरगणान् the hosts of gods, अपि even, किम् what, पुनः then, त्वाम् you, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, क्षुत्पिपासावशम् under the sway of hunger and thirst, गतम् fallen.

40022540.author: Translation
40022540.content: Indeed, O gentle one, he is capable of saving even the hosts of gods; how much more so can he save you, O mighty-armed one, who have fallen under the sway of hunger and thirst?

40022541.author: पदार्थः
40022541.content: सः that, अहम् I, भगवतः of the venerable one, श्रुत्वा having heard, देवदेवस्य of the god of gods, निश्चयम् the resolve, आहारम् food, गर्हितम् condemned, स्वशरीरम् my own body, द्विजोत्तम O best of brahmins.

40022541.author: Translation
40022541.content: O best of brahmins, having heard the resolve of the venerable god of gods (Shiva), I consider my own body as condemned food.

40022542.author: पदार्थः
40022542.content: बहून् many, वर्षगणान् years, ब्रह्मन् O Brahmin, भुज्यमानम् being consumed, इदम् this, मया by me, क्षयम् destruction, न not, अभ्येति reaches, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, तृप्तिः satisfaction, च and, अपि also, मम my, उत्तमा supreme.

40022542.author: Translation
40022542.content: O Brahmin, O Brahmarshi, though this body has been consumed by me for many years, it does not undergo destruction, and my satisfaction is also supreme.

40022543.author: पदार्थः
40022543.content: तस्य of that, मे me, कृच्छ्रभूतस्य who has fallen into distress, कृच्छ्रात् from distress, अस्मात् from this, विमोचय release, अन्येषां for others, न not, गतिः a way, हि indeed, अत्र here, कुम्भयोनिम् the pot-born, ऋते without, द्विजम् the brahmin.

40022543.author: Translation
40022543.content: Therefore, release me, who am in this great distress, from this predicament, for indeed, there is no other way or refuge here for anyone except the pot-born brahmin (Agastya).

40022544.author: पदार्थः
40022544.content: इदम् this, आभरणम् ornament, सौम्य O gentle one, तारणार्थम् for deliverance, द्विजोत्तम O best of brahmins, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व please accept, भद्रम् good fortune, ते to you, प्रसादम् favor, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.

40022544.author: Translation
40022544.content: O gentle one, O best of brahmins, please accept this ornament for my deliverance; may good fortune be yours, and you ought to grant this favor.

40022545.author: पदार्थः
40022545.content: इदम् this, तावत् indeed, सुवर्णम् gold, च and, धनम् wealth, वस्त्राणि clothes, च and, द्विज O brahmin, भक्ष्यम् food to be chewed, भोज्यम् food to be eaten, च and, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, ददाति gives, आभरणानि ornaments, च and.

40022545.author: Translation
40022545.content: O brahmin, O Brahmarshi, this indeed gives gold, wealth, clothes, food to be chewed, food to be eaten, and ornaments.

40022546.author: पदार्थः
40022546.content: सर्वान् all, कामान् desires, प्रयच्छामि I grant, भोगांश्च and enjoyments, मुनिपुङ्गव O best among sages, तारणे for crossing over, भगवन् O venerable one, मह्यं to me, प्रसादं grace, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.

40022546.author: Translation
40022546.content: The king pleaded with Agastya, "O best among sages, O venerable one, I grant all desires and enjoyments; please grant me the favor of liberation."

40022547.author: पदार्थः
40022547.content: तस्य his, अहं I, स्वर्गिणो of the one desiring heaven, वाक्यं word, श्रुत्वा having heard, दुःखसमन्वितम् filled with sorrow, तारणाय for liberation, उपजग्राह I accepted, तदाभरणम् that ornament, उत्तमम् excellent.

40022547.author: Translation
40022547.content: Having heard the sorrowful plea of that king who desired heaven, I accepted his excellent ornament for the purpose of his liberation.

40022548.author: पदार्थः
40022548.content: मया by me, प्रतिगृहीते having been accepted, तु indeed, तस्मिन् in that, आभरणे ornament, शुभे auspicious, मानुषः human, पूर्वको former, देहः body, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, विननाश perished, ह indeed.

40022548.author: Translation
40022548.content: Indeed, as soon as that auspicious ornament was accepted by me, the former human body of that royal sage perished.

40022549.author: पदार्थः
40022549.content: प्रनष्टे having perished, तु indeed, शरीरे body, असौ that, राजर्षिः royal sage, परया with supreme, मुदा joy, तृप्तः satisfied, प्रमुदितो greatly delighted, राजा king, जगाम went, त्रिदिवं to heaven, सुखम् happily.

40022549.author: Translation
40022549.content: Indeed, when his body perished, that royal sage, the king, filled with supreme joy, satisfied and greatly delighted, happily ascended to heaven.

40022550.author: पदार्थः
40022550.content: तेन by him, इदं this, शक्रतुल्येन by one equal to Indra, दिव्यम् divine, आभरणं ornament, मम to me, तस्मिन् on that, निमित्ते occasion, काकुत्स्थ O descendant of Kakutstha, दत्तम् given, अद्भुतदर्शनम् of wondrous appearance.

40022550.author: Translation
40022550.content: O Kakutstha, this divine ornament of wondrous appearance was given to me by that king, who was equal to Indra, on that very occasion. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे ऽष्टसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 78 ।। Thus ends the seventy-eighth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
